title: EasyFoam: Skill-Oriented OpenFOAM Agents with Evidence-Driven Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.14525v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of automating end-to-end OpenFOAM workflows for computational fluid dynamics (CFD). However, current progress is bottlenecked by two critical limitations. First, existing evaluations are dominated by tutorial-level cases and execution-oriented metrics, masking a substantial executability--acceptability gap: successfully executed simulations often fail to satisfy prescribed numerical or quantity-of-interest (QoI) criteria. Second, domain expertise in existing systems is tightly coupled with bespoke agent architectures, limiting its reuse and continual refinement across agent implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce ExtFoamBench, a challenging benchmark for OpenFOAM agents that spans five axes of workflow variation, and separately assesses execution completion, numerical soundness, and QoI satisfaction. Complementing this, we propose EasyFoam, an agent framework

translated_title: EasyFoam：基于证据驱动演化的面向技能的OpenFOAM智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自动化计算流体动力学（CFD）端到端OpenFOAM工作流方面的能力日益增强。然而，当前的进展受到两个关键限制的瓶颈制约。首先，现有评估主要依赖教程级别的案例和以执行为导向的指标，掩盖了显著的可执行性—可接受性差距：成功执行的模拟往往无法满足规定的数值或感兴趣量标准。其次，现有系统中的领域专业知识与定制化的智能体架构紧密耦合，限制了其在不同智能体实现之间的复用与持续改进。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ExtFoamBench，一个具有挑战性的OpenFOAM智能体基准测试，它涵盖五个维度的工作流变化，并分别评估执行完成度、数值合理性和QoI满足度。与此互补的是，我们提出了EasyFoam，一个智能体框架（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了从执行完成度、数值合理性和QoI满足度三个层面评估OpenFOAM智能体的挑战性基准ExtFoamBench，并配套提出EasyFoam框架，将领域技能与智能体架构解耦，实现证据驱动的持续演化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ExtFoamBench, a challenging benchmark that separately assesses execution completion, numerical soundness, and QoI satisfaction for OpenFOAM agents, and proposes EasyFoam, a skill-oriented agent framework that decouples domain expertise from agent architectures for evidence-driven continual evolution.
